As Merv slowly gets his groove back, turns out fixing their dog's broken heart may lead to a few sparks of their own.
movie:1255775.tagline: A different breed of romantic comedy.

movie:13975.overview: Lt. Dave Robicheaux, a detective in New Iberia, Louisiana, is trying to link the murder of a local hooker to New Orleans mobster Julie 'Baby Feet' Balboni, who is co-producer of a Civil War film. When the star of the film,  Elrod Sykes, reports finding another corpse in the Atchafalaya Swamp near the movie set, Robicheaux starts another investigation, believing the corpse to be the remains of a black man whose murder he witnessed 35 years earlier.
movie:13975.tagline: NO ONE CAN ESCAPE THE SINS OF THE PAST
movie:13975.title: In the Electric Mist

And the couple must remember that even if they love each other, the Prizzis love only money.

tv:2875.overview:
He's everyone's favorite action hero... but he's a hero with a difference. Angus MacGyver is a secret agent whose wits are his deadliest weapon. Armed with only a knapsack filled with everyday items he picks up along the way, he improvises his way out of every peril the bad guys throw at him.

Making a bomb out of chewing gum? Fixing a speeding car's brakes... while he's riding in it? Using soda pop to cook up tear gas? That's all in a day's adventures for MacGyver. He's part Boy Scout, part genius. And all hero.
tv:2875.tagline: His mind is the ultimate weapon.
